evidence.subject: 이메일 주소 확인
evidence.security_note: The email contains a sensitive confirmation URL/token. Never store or reproduce that URL/token in GitHub, logs, or chat.

objective: Confirm inside authentic PayPal that support@coshuma.com is a confirmed email address before any affiliate payout configuration relies on it.
safe_method: Open the authentic PayPal message in support@coshuma.com or sign directly into paypal.com.
Complete the email-ownership confirmation only on PayPal.
Verify PayPal shows support@coshuma.com as confirmed/usable.
After confirmation, review each affiliate platform payout setting separately; do not assume confirmation means a commission was paid.
do_not: Do not store or paste the PayPal confirmation token anywhere.
Do not expose a private PayPal login email on COSHUMA public pages.
Do not make test payments, purchases, transfers, or withdrawals.
Do not change affiliate payout destinations until PayPal confirmation is proven.
Do not infer payout or revenue from email confirmation alone.
done_when: PayPal itself shows support@coshuma.com as confirmed and the evidence is recorded without any secret or private account identifier.
